hero.headline:
Your own AI workspace,
running on your hardware.
hero.lede: Odysseus is a self-hosted interface for talking to language models — chat, autonomous agents, tools, model serving, email, research, and more. Local-first, privacy-first, and no telemetry. Just you and your models.

how.heading: Odysseus is everything I hate, just making it tolerable.
how.p1: I started working on the Odysseus project because running local AI felt fun — a step into the future. But the options to actually engage with LLMs felt like taking steps back. Where were features like Memory, Deep Research, Agents, and just basic integrations?!
how.p2: So I started building my own, for fun — and eventually figured it might be fun to share what I built for myself with others. Doesn't work for you? Well… it runs great on my hardware.

add.import_desc: Import a .txt, .md, .pdf, .csv, .log, .json, .py, .js, or .html file — the AI reads it and suggests candidate memories you can approve. Needs an open chat session (it uses that session's model).

memory.browse_desc: Long-term facts the AI remembers across chats — recall, edit, or curate.

settings.auto_approve_sub: Audit all publishes passing, necessary skills at or above this confidence. Off = keep audit results as drafts unless manually approved.
settings.auto_extract_skills_sub: Automatically draft reusable skills from your workflows. Audit all can publish passing skills using the threshold below.
settings.auto_extract_skills_sub2: The library can grow; cleanup retires weak/duplicate skills only after review.
settings.inject_skills_hint: Set to 0 to disable skill injection.
settings.inject_skills_sub: Controls how many relevant published or approved skills are added to each agent request.

skill.add_desc: Create a skill by hand — title, what it solves, and an approach.
skill.audit_all_title: Test every skill, auto-fix the weak ones, flag what still fails
skill.delete_nonpassing_title: Delete selected duplicates, generic/irrelevant skills, failed audits, and skills below threshold
skill.how_hint: — the approach, steps, commands, or rules to follow
skill.inject_title: Inject relevant skills into chat context
skill.list_desc: Reusable procedures the AI can call via /skill — sort by confidence to surface the proven ones.
skill.when_hint: — what problem does this skill solve?

memory.tidy_title: AI tidy: deduplicate and clean up memories

character.name: Name
character.style_ph: Write rough notes and click Expand, or leave empty

inject.max_tokens_hint: Maximum length of the AI response. 'No limit' lets the model decide when to stop.
inject.temperature_hint: Controls randomness. Lower values give focused, deterministic answers (good for code). Higher values give more creative, varied responses.

ai.add_fallback_title: Add a model to try if the one above fails
ai.add_fallback_utility_title: Add a model to try if the utility model fails
ai.add_fallback_vision_title: Add a vision model to try if the one above fails
ai.agent_sub: Controls for the agent tool loop.
ai.default_chat_model_sub: The model used when creating a new chat session.
ai.image_gen_sub: Configure which model to use for image generation.
ai.research_model_sub: Model used for Deep Research. Falls back to the default chat model if not set.
ai.teacher_model_sub: When a self-hosted student fails an agent-mode task, escalate to a SOTA teacher that writes a SKILL.md procedure so the student can do it next time. Off by default.
ai.tts_sub: Configure TTS provider for assistant message read-aloud.
ai.utility_model_sub: Runs background tasks (compaction, cleanup, auto-naming) on a small/local model instead of your chat model. Leave blank to use the chat model.
ai.vision_sub: Analyze images with a vision-capable model.

language.hint: Changes the language of the Odysseus interface. Untranslated text falls back to English.

language.title: Language

vis.sensitive_blur_hint: Blur emails, tokens, and secrets in AI output
vis.settings_btn_hint: Cog next to user — re-open with /settings

email.accounts_sub: Configure one or more IMAP/SMTP accounts. The default account is used when nothing else is selected.
email.writing_style_ph: e.g. I write emails in this style. I don't use exclamation marks. I sign emails with: ...
email.writing_style_sub: AI-extracted from your sent emails. Used when AI drafts replies.

integrations.connections_sub: All external service connections in one place.

reminders.ai_synthesis_sub: When on, the utility model writes a short, warm one-line reminder for browser, email, AND ntfy reminders instead of just the raw note content.

reminders.how_sub: Controls how fired note reminders are delivered.
reminders.public_url_sub: Used to build clickable links back to Odysseus inside outgoing reminder / urgent-email emails (e.g. https://chat.yourdomain.com). Leave blank to omit links.
reminders.test_sub: Fire a test reminder using your current settings to verify everything works.

search.fallbacks_title: Providers tried in order when the primary fails or hits a rate limit
search.test_title: Run a test query against the configured provider
search.web_search_sub: Search API used for web search and deep research.

services.add_models_sub: Connect to a cloud API or scan your network for a local model server.
services.local_url_ph: Paste an endpoint URL, e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1

shortcuts.hint: Click a shortcut to rebind. Press Escape to cancel.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts

system.danger_zone_sub: Irreversible. Each wipe targets one category — pick exactly what you want gone.
system.data_backup_sub: Export or import your user data (memories, presets, settings, skills, preferences) as a JSON file.
system.wipe_calendar_sub: Every event and every calendar (incl. CalDAV-synced ones; resync to restore).
system.wipe_chats_sub: Every session, message, and chat history. Documents/notes/etc. stay.
system.wipe_documents_sub: Every document and version. Drafts, exports, library — all gone.
system.wipe_gallery_sub: Every image record and the upload directory on disk.
system.wipe_memory_sub: Clears `memory.json`, the Memory table, and the vector store. Skills not affected.
system.wipe_skills_sub: Drops `data/skills/` (all SKILL.md files). Memory not affected.
system.wipe_tasks_sub: Every scheduled task and its run history (Tasks tool).
